checked_scope: The distribution-function upper bound with arbitrary within-network dependence, the block variant, and the variance decomposition.
checks: Random uniform node selection within each independent network makes the full estimator a conditional expectation; convex squared supremum Jensen is applicable without within-network independence.
Symmetrization factor four and Doob squared maximal factor four give 16C/K using R²≤CR and ER=1. Clipping yields the additional risk bound one.

Shared independent R gives ER² F(1−F)/m+Var(R)F²; full weighted-block independence and valid local weights support block improvement, while common whole-network shocks supply the fixed-C 1/K obstruction.
